description: Block rendering a tree of descendant child pages under a configurable root page and depth. Editable configuration exposes root and depth selectors and a show-icons toggle, with loading, empty, and source-deleted states.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: Owning page block used to resolve the current page when no root page is configured.

parameters.name: OnContentChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the block configuration changes.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Raised when the block receives focus.
